title: cs-daily-scratchpad-nina-patel-2026-03-24
content:
Date: 2026-03-24 - Nina

Quick morning scratchpad — focus: QBR prep + upcoming renewals + outstanding support follow-ups. Raw notes, action items, and candidate agenda.

Top priorities (today)
- [ ] BrightHealth QBR: finalize agenda & share with AE (Jordan) by EOD. Customer expects updated latency/cost dashboard and a short demo of caching improvements.
  - QBR date: 2026-03-30 (confirm)
  - Owner: Jordan Lee (cc: Nina)
  - Needs from engineering: 90/95th latency by region + recent incident summary (OPS-987)
  - Action: ping infra SRE for last 30-day latency graphs — Priya to pull graphs.

- [ ] Acme Retail renewal: negotiation call prep (discount ask pending). Renewal date 2026-04-15.
  - Current ARR: ~$72k/yr
  - Open items: SSO + SCIM completion, data residency addendum (legal), usage spike in Jan flagged — need cost breakdown.
  - Action: collect SSO rollout checklist from Private Deployments PM (Confluence link).

- [ ] ZenFin support backlog: tickets >7d — escalate if no owner
  - CS-1420 (model regression on summarize endpoint) — assigned to eng-applied-ml but no ETA. Need to push for triage by EOD.
  - CS-1378 (embedding mismatch) — follow-up email sent, waiting on customer logs.

Agenda sketch for BrightHealth QBR (short)
1) Welcome + agenda (5m)
2) Usage & unit economics (10m) — tokens/day, cost-per-req, suggestions (Redwood Optimize quick wins)
3) Performance & reliability (10m) — 95th/99th latency, incident review, mitigation (caching/quantization)
4) Roadmap items relevant (5m) — dedicated capacity, private deploy options
5) Renewal/contract timeline + next steps (5m)

People to ping
- Priya Natarajan: latency graphs + infra incident summary (OPS-987)
- Jordan Lee: share draft agenda + coordinate invite
- Matt (solutions eng): demo runthrough for caching improvements (timeslot request)
- Legal: data residency clause status for Acme Retail

Support follow-ups / quick wins
- Drop a note to applied-ml on CS-1420 — ask for temporary mitigation (roll back quantization) to stop regression.
- Ask SRE to confirm autoscale logs for BrightHealth during Feb spike (link to logs in OPS ticket).
- For embedding mismatch, request customer to run minimal repro and share sample IDs (offer to run a debug session).

Meeting invites to send today
- Draft BrightHealth QBR invite (30m) + include Jordan, Priya, Matt, legal rep
- Renewal prep sync with Acme AE (15m)

Misc notes / reminders to self
- Update Confluence QBR template with the new latency slide we used last week — file: /display/CS/QBR+Templates (add BrightHealth metrics example)
- Add a short note to renewal tracker spreadsheet about Acme's ask for a multi-region SLA
- Keep a short bulleted record of proposed discounts and rationale for Acme (cost per token, committed volume)

Open questions
- Do we have a standardized lane for temporary mitigations (rollback quantization) documented anywhere? If not, create a short runbook.
- Confirm who owns data-residency addendum templates in Legal.

End of scratchpad — will prune and convert to action items after quick sync with Jordan at 10:30am.
